profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at NMI
profile.summary:
"I prefer to speak in code over English, anyday!"
Yes, I meant it! After Vietnamese, I suppose that code is my 2nd language. I've come to web development somewhat recently, but I've long felt a love for technology. My natural grasp for coding has confirmed what I always thought would be the truth, this is where I should've been all along.

I love PHP, Javascript and Ruby! I love being in an industry that necessitates that I learn something new nearly everyday! I love that my curious nature and drive for new knowledge comes in handy, ALL THE TIME! I love contributing to, building, and supporting teams! 

I'm eager to learn, more eager to solve problems. That's who I am. Every problem is a puzzle and an opportunity to learn and discover. I would love to meet people doing cool things with Javascript and Ruby. Drop my a line if you're looking for someone who is hungry to learn, hungry to work and hungry to invest and give back to a team. 

Languages: PHP, JavaScript, Ruby, HTML5, CSS3, SQL
Frameworks: AngularJS, NodeJS, ExpressJS, Rails, CodeIgniter
Databases: MongoDB, mySQL, SQLite, ActiveRecord, PostgreSQL
Servers: NodeJS, Apache
Concepts: Object-Oriented Programming, Test-Driven Development, Error-Driven Development, API 
Deployment: Amazon Web Service (AWS), Heroku

PS...You can also drop me a line if you're searching for a good Banh mi. I got you!

positions.title: PHP Web Developer
positions.description:
Streamline production by promptly detecting and resolving issues that are reported by the business team and/or user. Implement new features and improve current features to enhance performance, speed, and space provided for websites. Discover any error/bug with the website to avoid future malfunctions
Key Achievements:
♣	Upgraded company website to align with technological advancements and meet the needs of the user. 
♣	Provided technical support to clients and team as necessary to maintain productivity. 
♣	Used several technical platforms, including MySQL, CodeIgniter 2, Twig, AJAX, JQUERY, Virtual Box, Vagrant, Gitlab, and DataMaper to improve the website usability for both the client and the business

positions.title: Residence Web Developer
positions.description:
Supported students in completing their projects using LAMP, MEAN and Ruby on Rails stacks. Fine tune my skills with coding to accommodate both basic and advanced technical needs of the student. Learned new technology for programming. Led three website and web game projects that included distributing task to a team of four staff to perform wireframing from concept to creation, database structuring, backend implementation, and functionality. Oversaw AWS deployment.
Key Projects:
♣	Motopage: Built website for motocross community using Rails, Bootstrap, Paperclip, and Bcript. 
♣	Empire: Created web game using M.E.A.N, JQuery, Stripe API and Bcript.
♣	Ecomix: Completed web project using L.A.M.P with CodeIgniter MVC, JQuery, Stripe API.

positions.title: Medi-Cal Collector/ Pharmacist Tech
positions.description:
Prepared bags of IV solution per MD/Pharmacist order. Accurately labeled, packaged, and stored products prior to shipment. Maintained a clean and organized pharmacy to meet health and safety standards.
Key Achievements:
♣	Gained knowledge of pharmacy terminology and medication names, to assist the department.
♣	Consistently prioritized work so that prescriptions were filled and completed in a timely manner.
♣	Clearly explained medical information and terminology to patients and customers.

positions.title: Manager
positions.description:
Provided motivation team leadership to ensure company standards for quality and service are exceeded by each team member.
Key Achievements:
♣	Cultivated a respectful environment between kitchen and bar operations, resulting in improved productivity, customer service, and staff longevity.
♣	Planned and designed innovative menus to create variety for regular customers while utilizing seasonal foods to control material costs.
♣	Provided outstanding guest service to retain and grow customer base.
